name: Baseball Trivia
description: Rules, legends, ballparks and famous records from America’s pastime.
question: {prompt}

cards.prompt: How many players does a baseball team have on the field on defense?
cards.fact: The nine are the pitcher, catcher, four infielders and three outfielders.

cards.prompt: How many outs does a team get in its half of an inning?
cards.fact: Three outs per side means six outs in a full inning.

cards.prompt: How many strikes make a strikeout?
cards.fact: A foul ball counts as a strike, but it can’t be the third strike unless it’s a bunt.

cards.prompt: How many balls earn the batter a walk?
cards.fact: A walk is officially called a "base on balls."

cards.prompt: How many innings are in a regulation Major League game?
cards.fact: Tied games go to extra innings until one team leads at the end of an inning.

cards.prompt: How far apart are the bases in Major League Baseball?
cards.fact: The 90-foot distance has been standard since the 1870s.

cards.prompt: How far is the pitching rubber from home plate in MLB?
cards.fact: The distance was set in 1893 and hasn’t changed since.

cards.prompt: What is a home run with the bases loaded called?
cards.fact: A grand slam scores four runs, the most possible on one swing.

cards.prompt: A single, double, triple and home run by one batter in one game is called what?
cards.fact: The triple is usually the hardest part of the cycle to get.

cards.prompt: What is it called when a pitcher lets no opposing batter reach base in a complete game?
cards.fact: A no-hitter allows no hits; a perfect game also allows no walks, errors or hit batters.

cards.prompt: In baseball stats, what does "RBI" stand for?
cards.fact: A batter earns an RBI for each run that scores because of their plate appearance.

cards.prompt: In baseball, what does "DH" stand for?
cards.fact: The American League adopted the DH in 1973; the National League followed in 2022.

cards.prompt: Which song is traditionally sung during the seventh-inning stretch?
cards.answer: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
alts: Take Me Out to the Ballgame
cards.fact: It was written in 1908 by two men who had reportedly never been to a game.

cards.prompt: Which slugger was nicknamed "The Sultan of Swat" and "The Bambino"?
cards.fact: Ruth began his career as a star pitcher for the Boston Red Sox.

cards.prompt: Which Yankees first baseman was nicknamed "The Iron Horse"?
cards.fact: Gehrig played 2,130 consecutive games, a record that stood for 56 years.

cards.prompt: Jackie Robinson broke MLB’s color barrier in 1947 with which team?
cards.fact: Every MLB player wears his number 42 on Jackie Robinson Day, April 15.

cards.prompt: Which jersey number is retired across all of Major League Baseball?
cards.fact: MLB retired 42 for every team in 1997 to honor Jackie Robinson.

cards.prompt: Who holds the record for most consecutive games played, at 2,632?
cards.fact: Ripken passed Lou Gehrig’s 2,130 in 1995 and kept going until 1998.

cards.prompt: Who holds MLB’s career record for hits, with 4,256?
cards.fact: Rose passed Ty Cobb’s long-standing mark of about 4,190 hits in 1985.

cards.prompt: Who holds MLB’s career home run record, with 762?
cards.fact: Bonds passed Hank Aaron’s 755 in 2007.

cards.prompt: Barry Bonds set the single-season home run record in 2001. How many did he hit?
cards.fact: Bonds broke Mark McGwire’s record of 70, set just three years earlier.

cards.prompt: In 1974, Hank Aaron broke whose career home run record?
cards.fact: Aaron’s 715th home run came on April 8, 1974, in Atlanta.

cards.prompt: Who was the last MLB player to bat .400 for a season, hitting .406 in 1941?
cards.fact: Williams played both games of a season-ending doubleheader rather than sit to protect his average.

cards.prompt: Joe DiMaggio’s famous 1941 hitting streak lasted how many games?
cards.fact: No one has come within 10 games of the streak since.

cards.prompt: Which pitcher won a record 511 career games and now has an award named after him?
cards.fact: The Cy Young Award for the best pitcher began in 1956.

cards.prompt: Which pitcher threw a record seven career no-hitters?
cards.fact: Ryan also holds the career strikeout record, with 5,714.

cards.prompt: Who set MLB’s single-season hits record with 262 in 2004?
cards.fact: Ichiro broke George Sisler’s record of 257, which had stood since 1920.

cards.prompt: What is the nickname of the tall left-field wall at Boston’s Fenway Park?
cards.fact: The wall stands about 37 feet tall and has a hand-operated scoreboard.

cards.prompt: Which team plays at Wrigley Field, famous for its ivy-covered outfield walls?
cards.fact: Wrigley Field opened in 1914, making it the second-oldest ballpark in MLB.

cards.prompt: Which team ended the "Curse of the Bambino" by winning the 2004 World Series?
cards.fact: It was Boston’s first title since 1918; soon after that win, the team sold Babe Ruth to the Yankees.

cards.prompt: Which team won the 2016 World Series, ending a 108-year championship drought?
cards.fact: The Cubs won Game 7 in extra innings in Cleveland.

cards.prompt: Which franchise has won the most World Series titles?
cards.fact: The Yankees have 27 titles; no other team has more than a dozen.

cards.prompt: In which village is the National Baseball Hall of Fame?
cards.fact: The Hall of Fame opened in 1939; Cooperstown was once said to be where baseball was invented.
